rules.statement: A decree entered under the Partition Act that is not in accordance with the findings in the judgment lacks final and conclusive effect, and can be amended to conform with the judgment.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where, in an action governed by the Partition Act, the decree which the Court purports to enter under s. 26 of the Act is not in accordance with the findings in the judgment, such decree is not an interlocutory decree which has a final and conclusive effect under s. 48 (1)."
